thread.title: Tech Wreck: Corning, Micron, T.I Among Thursday’s Battered

author: Tiernan Ray
title: Tech Wreck: Corning, Micron, T.I Among Thursday’s Battered
text:
Amidst today’s drop of 2.4% in the Nasdaq Composite Index — slightly less bad than the almost 3% drop in the Dow — pain was distributed across multiple industries within tech.
Some of the worst hit include venerable names in the bare metal of communications and electronics, such s Corning ( GLW ), down 2.8%, and connector component maker Amphenol ( APH ), down 3%.
Semiconductors had some big losers, including Texas Instruments ( TXN ), down 4.4%, and chip equipment vendors KLA-Tencor ( KLAC ), down 4.4%, and Lam Research ( LRX ), down 4.2%.
Micron Technology ( MU ), which was headed toward a fiscal Q2 report generally of very upbeat expectations, dropped 3.5%, and its shares continued to trade down in this evening’s after-hours session even though the report was, indeed, upbeat , and the outlook topped consensus as well.
Micron shares, however, quickly regained lost ground and were down only 20 cents at $58.74 as of this writing.
Of course, Facebook ( FB ) traded down a little worse than the Nasdaq after CEO and founder Mark Zuckerberg explained Wednesday evening his company’s thinking about the notorious data leak, falling 2.7%, but worse hit than Facebook was Alphabet ( GOOGL ), down 3.7%.
Other standout losers were European chip giant STMicroelectronics ( STM ), down almost 6%, Twitter ( TWTR ), down almost 5%, and Arista Networks ( ANET ), down 3%.
Among the ones holding up better today were Box ( BOX ), whose similar-sounding cousin Dropbox ( DBX ) is to open for trading tomorrow. Box closed up 3 cents at $22.75. Snap ( SNAP ) closed unchanged. Broadcom ( AVGO ) was down only 1%, and Apple ( AAPL ) finished the session down just 1.4%.
